plugins.name: CAP Token Usage Tracker (fork)
plugins.description: Fork of AITNR/cap-token-usage-tracker. Date presets include the current day and gain an "All" range, the per-request table shows the model alias, model prices resolve through the alias, the full-mode reset route no longer 404s, and the enriched dashboard is the default with API keys masked server-side while management actions still require the management key.
